business_summary: Shanghai INT Medical Instruments Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of cardiovascular interventional medical devices in Mainland China, Europe, the United States, and internationally. It offers transradial and femoral pressure bandage, hydrophilic guidewire, pressure Y-connector set, PTFE guidewire, PTCA balloon dilatation catheter, noncompliant balloon dilatation catheter, compression femoral artery tourniquet, vascular sheaths for single use, push-to-thread balloon dilation pressure pump, guide extension catheter, angiography catheter, guiding catheter, micro guidewire and catheter, cardiac valves balloon inflation catheter, guidewire, introducer set, braided introducer sheath, inflation device, pressure transducer, manifold kit, stopcocks, sterile seldinger needle, Y-connector pack, extension tube, high pressure manifold, and angiography syringe products. The company also provides medical electric suction pumps, intracranial thrombus aspiration and balloon guiding catheters, sterile suction pipettes, embolic protectors, angiography and distal access catheters, and pressure bandages; biodegradable sinus drug stent and thrombus aspiration systems, perfusion catheters, and biodegradable drug eluting sinus stents; joint intervention and introducer tool kits; and pressure controlled suction and single-use digital flexible ureteroscope products. In addition, it offers infusion connectors and accessories, disposable automatic umbilical cord clamps, burette infusion sets without needle, foley catheters, infusion pumps, vaginal dilators; 3D medical surgical fask masks, and disposal respirator FFP2 NR products; and valves, and metal wire processing and pressure gauges. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Kindly Medical Instruments Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanghai INT Medical Instruments Co., Ltd. in January 2024. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
